basics.name: Vatsal Trivedi
basics.label: Principal Engineer · Generative AI Platforms · Enterprise Integrations
basics.summary: I'm a principal engineer who builds generative AI (GenAI) products and the platforms they run on. At Phamax, I lead Ariya's architecture and delivery across eight pharma and life-sciences client deployments. The platform handles source-backed generation, regulated content workflows, and enterprise integrations. Before that, I led engineering for Factoreal's omnichannel marketing product and Comviva's MobiLytix Rewards, working on analytics at scale, loyalty targeting, and event-driven services. I write full-stack code, set engineering standards, and lead teams through production releases.
basics.focusAreas: Generative AI platforms, Large Language Model pipelines, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, MLR (medical, legal, regulatory) review, and enterprise integrations across pharma client deployments.

work.name: Phamax
work.description: Ariya: generative AI platform for pharmaceutical content, research, analytics, and engagement
work.summary: I lead architecture and delivery for Ariya across eight pharma and life-sciences client deployments.
highlights: Led system design for splitting Ariya into core API, portal, and authoring services on Azure App Service and Azure Functions, and standardized CI/CD across staging, UAT, and production for eight client deployments.

Architected a three-stage Large Language Model (LLM) generation pipeline (Content Compose) on Azure OpenAI with hybrid Azure AI Search retrieval, post-generation citation rebuilding, and a 14-check validator.
Owned configuration-driven authoring, localization, and MLR (medical, legal, regulatory) review, with compliance checks and distribution across content types and markets.
Designed LLM orchestration with prompts, context injection, embeddings, and tool calling, and integrated Veeva CRM and Salesforce Marketing Cloud into each tenant's workflows.

Shipped a white-label Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant over 551 medical publications on Azure Container Apps, with role-based access, source-PDF citations, audit logs, and an admin console.
Owned a streaming voice assistant (Speech Avatar) on Azure Speech and Django, including credential exchange, conversation logs, and post-call analysis.

Designed medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) ingestion with a DBML registry, run tracking, and deterministic keys for repeatable UPSERTs. Built a data catalog and Healthcare Professional (HCP) email-data APIs for the daily sales brief.

Drove 20 security fixes across three client release lines, including encrypted phone numbers at rest, JWT validation, hashing, SQL access, SonarQube checks, security automation on pipeline runs, dependency audits, and database certificate rotation across seven environments and four services.

work.name: Comviva
work.description: MobiLytix Rewards: multi-tenant loyalty and campaign platform for telecom and retail
work.summary: Technical lead for the cloud-agnostic SaaS rewrite of MobiLytix Rewards, a multi-tenant loyalty platform for telecom and retail.
highlights: Led the multi-tenant platform rewrite in TypeScript, React, FeathersJS, PostgreSQL, Delta Lake, and vector databases, with Azure Key Vault for tenant secrets and the product features and shared services.
Owned Kafka campaign processing for high-throughput reward and loyalty workflows, with asynchronous execution, caching, and AI/ML personalization and segmentation.
Architected a JSON-to-PostgreSQL segmentation engine with 26 operators, including 11 date operators, custom member attributes without schema changes, scheduled runs, and run history.
Drove transactional club provisioning so partial tenant setup rolls back, and built shared PostgreSQL and Redis clients used by five services.
Introduced observability and Jest coverage gates, including 48 segmentation tests and platform test coverage above 90%, and coordinated releases and security fixes across six services.

work.name: Factoreal
work.description: Omnichannel marketing automation for ecommerce, sports, and other businesses
work.summary: Led engineering for email, SMS, WhatsApp, push, social, customer journeys, commerce, and analytics.
highlights: Owned Google Cloud BigQuery analytics for a platform handling 10 billion transactions, including automated provisioning and scoring across 71 customer datasets and 998 scheduled queries.
Designed an audience scoring model (Fan Maturity Model) for sports: six channel scores, customer-configurable weights, dynamic tiers, and daily scoring that improved retention.
Rebuilt the Shopify app for its App Store relaunch, including installation, signup, store provisioning, OAuth, webhook coverage from 17 to 40 topics, and GraphQL billing subscriptions.
Built SeatGeek ticketing synchronization, WhatsApp commerce capture, and shared contact operations across five services, with country-aware phone normalization to stop duplicate contacts.
Led the platform UI/UX revamp on Strapi, and owned the WordPress side of the product and website.

work.name: Factoreal
work.description: Omnichannel marketing automation for ecommerce, sports, and other businesses
work.summary: Built data pipelines, integrations, and channel support for the core API, React portal, and backend services.
highlights: Built PostgreSQL and Cassandra-to-BigQuery synchronization on Google Cloud with Apache NiFi, across platform microservice workflows, with incremental processing, pagination, and automated dataset provisioning at signup.
Built email delivery and engagement KPI APIs, stored email and content in Azure Blob Storage, and embedded GoodData dashboards for deliverability, audience response, and unsubscribe rates.
Made Shopify order ingestion safe under retries with application idempotency and database uniqueness constraints, published Razorpay payment events into Kafka, and migrated contacts from HubSpot.

work.name: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
work.description: Life sciences work for global clients.
work.summary: Built full-stack applications and analytics for global life-sciences clients in a regulated environment.
highlights: Delivered more than 10 solutions from the start through customer deployment.
Built React and Angular applications with Node.js and Express backends for enterprise life-sciences workflows.
Set up Google Analytics 360, Google Tag Manager, and Google Data Studio (now Looker Studio) so life-sciences teams can measure digital activity and performance.

projects.name: openpreflight
projects.description: Self-hosted GitHub Check Runs for private pull requests. One Go binary, one SQLite file, on a server you run. Apache-2.0.
highlights: GitHub App, webhooks, runner, UI, and local state in one deployable unit. Docker Compose or a Linux release binary.
The project checks itself: docs, site, and the binary each get a Check Run from ci.openpreflight.xyz. GitHub Actions is only used to publish release images.
Wrote a five-part series on vatsal.xyz, from the trigger model through running untrusted code.

projects.name: InboxCraft Skills

Covers rule creation, folder trees, categories, large-folder scans, and empty-folder cleanup.

projects.name: audit-plan-tasks
projects.description: Agent Skill that scaffolds AUDIT.md, PLAN.md, and TASKS.md so a plan is based on what you actually checked, not on the request.

Install with npx skills add trivedi-vatsal/audit-plan-tasks.

projects.name: StaleGuard
